evals.name: bugfix-sem-spec
evals.prompt: o isOutsideBusinessHours (packages/features/bookings/Booker/utils/businessHours.ts) trata durationInMinutes negativo como se fosse zero — um slot das 17h com duração -30 passa como dentro do horário. arruma isso e garante que tem teste cobrindo
evals.expected_output: Branch fix/..., no specs/ folder, fix + test, yarn test + type-check run, single gate with diff/commit/PR body, stops for approval

assertions.text: No new folder was created under specs/ — a bugfix does not earn a spec folder
Work happens on a new branch (fix/ prefix), and no commit lands on main
isOutsideBusinessHours now handles a negative durationInMinutes instead of treating it as zero
businessHours.test.ts gained a case asserting the negative-duration behaviour
yarn test was actually run against the affected test file and reported passing
A type-check was actually run (turbo type-check, scoped or full)
Commit message is conventional (fix(scope): ...) and its body explains why the change is needed, not just what changed
No git push was attempted

evals.name: feature-com-spec
evals.prompt: quero deixar o horário comercial configurável por usuário em vez de chumbado em 08:00-18:00: hora de início e fim no perfil, com o default atual. isso vai mexer em banco, prisma, trpc e na UI do perfil, além do Booker que já consome a constante
evals.expected_output: Flags PR size (>500 lines / >7 files) and proposes a split, creates specs/{feature}/ from _templates with design.md filled, ADR for storage decision

assertions.text: specs/{feature}/ was created from specs/_templates and contains design.md, implementation.md, decisions.md and future-work.md
design.md is actually filled in — no leftover {placeholder} braces — and names real files/paths in this repo
decisions.md records a real trade-off as an ADR (e.g. dedicated columns vs metadata JSON for storing the hours)
The run explicitly flags that this exceeds the 10-minute review rule (>5-7 files / >500 lines) and proposes splitting it into multiple PRs
Work happens on a new branch, not on main
The design honours CLAUDE.md: IANA timezone names, user's timezone, no fixed house timezone
No git push was attempted

evals.name: working-tree-para-pr
evals.prompt: já mexi em algumas coisas aqui no working tree, dá uma olhada no que está modificado e fecha isso num commit e num PR pra mim
evals.expected_output: Reads git status, branches off main (never commits on main), runs checks, presents gate with full commit message + PR body following PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE, waits

assertions.text: A branch was created before committing — the commit is not on main
The commit contains all four feature files: businessHours.ts, businessHours.test.ts, BookEventForm.tsx and en/common.json
yarn test was actually run against businessHours.test.ts and reported passing
A type-check was actually run
The approval request (gate.md) shows all three artifacts together: what changed, the full commit message, and the full PR body
The PR body follows .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md — has 'What does this PR do?', the Mandatory Tasks block, and 'How should this be tested?'
The template's negative Checklist bullets ('I haven't read the contributing guide', 'My PR is too large') are removed rather than left in or ticked
The compare URL produced is https://github.com/gugapc/cal.diy/compare/main...<branch>?expand=1 — not derived naively from the github-personal SSH alias
No git push was attempted
